cards.text: Friend, Judah just lost King Josiah, who turned to the LORD with all his heart like no king before or after him (2 Kings 23:25). Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, killed him at Megiddo, and the people made Josiah's son Jehoahaz king (2 Kings 23:29-30). Jehoahaz is twenty-three, and he reigns in Jerusalem three months.

cards.question: Of King Jehoahaz it is written, "And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done."

cards.text: Then Pharaoh Neco, the king who killed Josiah, steps in. He imprisons Jehoahaz at Riblah in the land of Hamath.

cards.question: Pharaoh Neco imprisons Jehoahaz at Riblah. Why?

answers.text: So he can't reign in Jerusalem
So he can serve in Egypt's army
So he can learn Egypt's ways

cards.text: Then Neco puts a levy on Judah: a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold. He's got their king locked up AND he's sending them the bill!

cards.question: With Jehoahaz locked up at Riblah, who makes the next king of Judah?

cards.text: Neco makes Eliakim, another son of Josiah, king, and he changes Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. Pharaoh picked the king AND wrote his name tag.

cards.question: Pharaoh Neco has his new king in Jerusalem. What does Neco do with Jehoahaz?

answers.text: Lets him go back to Jerusalem

cards.question: Jehoahaz makes it back from Egypt and reigns in Jerusalem again.

cards.text: Jehoahaz dies there in Egypt. Now King Jehoiakim has to pay Pharaoh all that silver and gold.

cards.question: To meet Pharaoh's demand, Jehoiakim taxes the land and takes the silver and gold from the people, each according to his ___.

cards.text: Jehoiakim becomes king at twenty-five and reigns in Jerusalem eleven years. ELEVEN YEARS is forty-four of his brother's whole reigns back to back!
And his record matches his brother's word for word: "And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done." Then Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, invades.

cards.question: Jehoiakim got his throne from Pharaoh Neco. Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invades. What does Jehoiakim do?
After three years of serving Nebuchadnezzar, Jehoiakim turns and rebels against him.

cards.text: Then the LORD sends raiders against Jehoiakim to destroy Judah: Chaldeans, Arameans, Moabites and Ammonites.

cards.question: The raiders come against Judah according to the word the LORD had spoken through His servants the ___.

cards.text: This happened at the LORD's command, to remove Judah from His presence because of the sins of Manasseh, an earlier king of Judah (2 Kings 21:1). Manasseh had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood.

cards.question: After all that innocent blood, the LORD was willing to forgive.
The rest of Jehoiakim's acts are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah. When he rests with his fathers, who reigns in his place?

cards.text: Egypt had been calling the shots in Judah, picking its king and collecting its silver and gold. But now the king of Egypt does not march out of his land again.

cards.question: The king of Egypt does not march out of his land again. Why not?

answers.text: Babylon had taken all his territory
He had made peace with Judah
A plague had struck his army

cards.text: From the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River, it's all Babylon's now, and Egypt is staying HOME. Keep that oven warm, friend, because Judah's story is not done yet.
